No ambient occlusion, specular highlight, rim light, gradient or glow. A LIT PANEL FACE IS AN EMISSIVE SURFACE INSIDE THE MODEL AND NEVER A LIGHT ADDED TO THE SCENE. No caption, legend, annotation, leader line, arrow, numeral, letter or watermark anywhere in the frame.

A scene frame, so the object-on-parchment rule is suspended for this frame alone: it has ground and sky. Stylised low-poly isometric toy Information Age town on a small round island, the whole island inside the frame.

An Information Age town that hides its infrastructure, four materials. Unitised curtain-wall glass as the body accent #7FA0A8, arriving as storey-high units with a visible mullion and transom grid and a spandrel panel at each floor -- the grid is the only texture and it must stay regular, because an irregular one reads as an earlier era. Anodised and composite rainscreen panel as the body #96A1AB, matte and close-toned and seamless at a distance, its narrow open joint the whole of the detail. Exposed structural steel, slender and pale, only where it is being expressed. Engineered stone cladding in large thin panels with tight joints, a facing and never a wall. Flat parapets, and A SHADOW GAP WHERE A BUILDING MEETS THE GROUND RATHER THAN A BASE. Body and accent sit close together on purpose, so a building has very little internal contrast. NOTHING SHOWS THAT A PERSON MADE IT: no board mark, tooled stone, laid course, lashing, rivet or brush stroke.

SUBJECT: the same town after a crisis that ENDED WITHOUT BEING SOLVED, UNDER ORDINARY FAIR DAYLIGHT WITH PART OF ITS FLOOR STILL OPEN. The crisis light has gone: an ordinary bright day, a warm calm sky, ordinary daytime shadows. Anodised grey-blue #96A1AB with glass #7FA0A8, flat parapets, a shadow gap at the ground line, precise banded unit paving #A9A49A over #948F86, planting lush and perfectly maintained.

THE MARKS: most of the paving has CLOSED BACK UP -- covers flush #918D84, squared to the module, aligned to the joints, the banded pattern running unbroken through them. But in TWO OR THREE PLACES THE COVERS ARE STILL LIFTED AND LEANING, their voids dark #2C3236, their low clad barriers #8B959C on posts #646B70 still standing round them. UNDER FAIR DAYLIGHT THE DARK VOIDS ARE WHAT CARRY THIS FRAME, exactly as under the crisis light, and the barriers stay quiet. ONE BUILDING STILL CARRIES FLUSH BLANKING PANELS #8B959C over its openings in its own module, with the small angled service isolation plate #4C565C at its front lower corner and its wall panel dark -- bezel #394045, face #262B2F, rim #2F353A. EVERY OTHER BUILDING'S WALL PANEL IS GONE, BECAUSE THE CRISIS IS OVER.

WHAT MUST READ, AT ANY ZOOM AND WITHOUT READING A SINGLE PANEL: THE PATTERN IS RESTORED ALMOST EVERYWHERE AND IS STILL BROKEN IN A FEW PLACES, and the town is otherwise entirely back to normal. The contrast between a closed cover and a still-open one has to be visible IN THE FLOOR ALONE.

WHAT IT MUST NOT RESEMBLE: a punishment. They separate on UNFINISHED AGAINST RUINED: this is a job nobody got round to completing, so the mood is calm rather than grim and nothing here is a ruin, a disaster aftermath, a condemned building, an abandoned town or a decayed one.

The eight rulings, which bind this frame:
- There is no edge layer. Nothing joins one building to another: no line, band, link, route, edge, path or run of anything. A duct or fibre marker is a mark on a place -- it never meets two thresholds, never runs continuously between buildings, is never notched, and is never anything a viewer could trace to learn what is connected to what.
- Everything the crisis adds to the town is the town's own anodised clad panel #8B959C on posts #646B70, and nothing in the frame is more saturated than the era's own glass accent #7FA0A8. No high-visibility colour and no warmth anywhere in what the crisis adds.
- A lit panel is a bright face, not a light source, and it lights nothing. This is not night and not dusk.
- A panel shows a countable row of lit bars, and on a stale reading one horizontal bar beneath the row. Nothing else. No text, numeral, letter, icon, graph, waveform, map or face on any face.
- A void is a dark solid shape you cannot see into, with nothing in it and nothing lit inside it.
- There is no visible intruder -- no agent, marker, trail, icon or anything representing whoever is doing this.
- Everything is clean, intact and maintained, and an isolated building is sealed, not boarded: blanking panels flush and in the building's own module.
- No mastery gold #FFB703.
